title: Sigma Notation and Limits of Finite Sums
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Sigma Notation and Linearity
definitions.latex: \sum_{k=1}^n (c a_k + d b_k) = c \sum_{k=1}^n a_k + d \sum_{k=1}^n b_k
definitions.statement: Sigma notation compactly represents sums of indexed terms. The summation operator is linear: constant factors factor out, and sums distribute across addition and subtraction.
conditions: c, d are constants independent of index k
definitions.explanation: Linearity enables algebraic decomposition of complex polynomials into elementary power sums.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Sigma notation is linear and distributes over addition.

definitions.title: Formulas for Sums of Powers of Integers
definitions.statement: Exact algebraic closed-form expressions for the sums of the first n positive integers, squares, and cubes.
definitions.explanation: These formulas provide the algebraic mechanism to compute limits of Riemann sums analytically without relying on antiderivatives.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Closed-form power sum formulas convert index sums into rational functions of n.
